notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 is live now!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30823549/7d66b227dedab4a0552c06406e16b39c97c1ed48.jpg

Update information

・Add new stage [CURRY].
・Adjust game balance.
・Add Tutorial.

・カレー好きの方に是非プレイして頂きたい！60種類のカレーを用意。「カレー」ステージ追加。
・ゲームバランスを調整。残りタイムが僅かの際に追加されるタイムを増加。より粘り強いプレイが可能に！
・チュートリアルに項目を追加。

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 is live now!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.1 is live now! 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30823549/502421ee25c603c29afbe56a1e1998d35c3187c0.jpg
Patch Highlights

	・Adjust game balance.

This game aimed at game play like an old Sega arcade game.
The influence is greatly influenced by Tanto-R, Edihon detective office, Outrun, Crazy taxi, etc. which are game titles that I am loving.

The story mode is a circulation type in which the story progresses each time it clears.
